purposes.seed: Repeatable authored geometry and review composition; does not change the game world seed.
purposes.branch_sides: Eight-sided wood keeps irregular trunks readable at player height within a small mesh budget.
purposes.bark_ridge_fraction: Depth of radial bark ridges relative to trunk radius; softens the smooth-pipe appearance.
purposes.leaf_colour_variation: Restrained leaf-to-leaf colour variety drawn from the existing habitat palette.
purposes.rock_colour_variation: Subtle planar mineral changes without noisy multicolour facets.
purposes.tree.height: Local crown height, following the existing meadow profile.
purposes.tree.trunk_radius: Visible trunk width at the ground, within the existing trunk collision envelope.
purposes.tree.crown_spread: Broadleaf branch reach; leaves leave readable sky gaps and standing space underneath.
purposes.tree.branches: Asymmetric scaffold branches supporting the crown silhouette, plus one terminal crown spray.
purposes.tree.sprays_per_branch: Small overlapping leaf sprays instead of solid ball-shaped crowns.
purposes.tree.leaves_per_spray: Foliage density and triangle cost; foliage remains opaque geometry.
purposes.tree.leaf_length: Leaf scale relative to a one-metre player view; keeps the canopy from looking like grass.
purposes.boulder.width/height/depth: Main rock silhouette scaled to the existing boulder collider dimensions.
purposes.boulder.burial: Rock below its surface anchor so the foot settles into soil.
purposes.boulder.moss_coverage: Sparse moss on upper weathered ledges; retains the harvestable stone read.
purposes.shrub.radius/height: Middle-height vegetation fitting the current 0.65-metre habitat footprint.
purposes.shrub.branches: Irregular pointed-leaf brush density, never a miniature tree canopy.
purposes.fern_bed.radius/height: Low spreading cover within the existing 0.5-metre habitat footprint.
purposes.fern_bed.fronds/leaf_pairs: Curved pinnate silhouette and mesh cost at player height.
purposes.deadfall.length/radius: Short rotten debris consistent with the current non-harvestable habitat detail.
purposes.deadfall.burial: A partly embedded base prevents floating woody debris.
purposes.stump.height/radius/root_radius: Low stump with exposed roots fitting the current 0.4-metre footprint.
purposes.stump.burial: Root ends sink below the surface anchor rather than hovering.
